fusions.name: Thin Slice
fusions.desc: Flicks a folded edge that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fine Print
fusions.desc: Flings a flurry of sheets through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 8 damage to everything in it. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Second Draft
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Revised Edition
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
